_proxy_ip_doc: Public-bridge VM is gcp-proxy (35.226.147.64). All A records resolve to it; Caddy on gcp-proxy fronts the WireGuard hub. Source of truth: _cloud-data-consolidated.json[.vms."gcp-E2-f_0".ip]. Phase 6 cutover to oci-analytics deferred until Caddy lives there.

dns_records._a_records_doc: extra_ips: optional list of additional A-record IPs for the same name (multi-value DNS). Engine emits one cloudflare_record per (name, ip). Use for mail-server hostnames so split-tunnel WG clients hit the wg0 IP directly (10.0.0.1 = gcp-proxy wg0 / Caddy L4 SNI mux) and skip the hairpin through the public edge. Public-only clients drop the unreachable RFC1918 IP after a single connect timeout and fall back to proxy_ip. RFC1918 leak is acceptable per operator policy (topology is already public). 10.0.0.1 is gcp-proxy wg0 IP — Caddy SNI mux on :443 routes IMAPS/SMTPS to Maddy at 10.0.0.3:993/465.
